# Mitra: The Financial Coordination Layer & Clearinghouse for Agentic Commerce

> Mitra is institutional market infrastructure for autonomous AI agents. It decouples trade intent from capital settlement: human principals engrave bounded mandates, off-chain policy engines evaluate intents with Arcium MPC, and an independent execution guard re-derives whether instructions may move capital.

## Core Architectural Invariants

- **`ALLOW != DISBURSEMENT`**: A policy approval verdict from `mitra_request_authorization` moves zero capital and reserves zero tokens. When funds disburse, the on-chain execution guard re-derives whether the exact instruction may move capital.
- **`MANDATE != RUNTIME FREEDOM`**: Mandates are persistent spending ceilings engraved by human principals. Agents negotiate runtime intents within these bounds but cannot alter their own ceilings.
- **`ENGRAVING != AUTHORIZATION`**: An engraving is a persistent budget ceiling whose headroom decrements monotonically. An authorization is a single-use token consumed atomically upon settlement.
- **`NETTING != SETTLEMENT`**: Multilateral cycle netting cancels offsetting obligations ($A \to B \to C \to A$) within a clearing epoch, moving only the residual net debt across blockchain rails.
- **Tri-Chain Peer Parity**: Solana Anchor, Base Sepolia (ERC-8183), and Tempo Moderato (TIP-20) are equal first-class peers.

## Machine-Accessible Interfaces

- **MCP Gateway:** Streamable HTTP / SSE on `http://localhost:3006/sse` or `bin/mitra-mcp.mjs` over stdio.
- **REST API:** `http://localhost:3005/api/v1/`
- **TypeScript SDK:** `npm install @mitra/sdk` (exports `.` and `./sdk` from `package.json`)
- **System Diagnostics:** `npm run doctor`
